verdict.rationale: Inngest explicitly supports cron-based scheduled functions with timezone support (inngest-docs-17/31) plus recurring/triggered workflows via durable steps, retries, and wait-for-event orchestration (inngest-docs-2, -18, -32), and community reports confirm real-world use for scheduling/queueing needs (inngest-comm-1). missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically of recurring cron scheduling (most community evidence is about general job/queue use, not cron recurrence specifically).
